name: Sonarr
summary: Ask for a television series and it finds, downloads and files each episode.
after_install: Sonarr handles television. Open it and set a password, then Settings, Download Clients, add qBittorrent with host qbittorrent and port 8081. Under Settings, Media Management add /data/shows as a root folder. Leave the indexers to Prowlarr.

storage.description: One folder holding both your downloads and your library. It must be a single location: a finished file is moved into place by being linked, which only works within one disk.

starts_as_root.reason: The linuxserver.io entrypoint starts as root, corrects ownership of its configuration and media folders, then drops to the account given in PUID and PGID using s6. It has no option to run as an arbitrary user.
